note_narrative:
This recording documents a live training session conducted by Coach Michelle (SPEAKER_0) with trainee Sharon McKenzie of Heavenly Healing Hands (SPEAKER_2). The session consisted of an unscripted intake role-play in which Coach Michelle portrayed a prospective family client and Sharon practiced conducting a home care meet-and-greet and intake. The role-play was broadcast to a coaching audience for educational purposes. This note documents the care recipient and care needs established within the role-play scenario only; no actual home care visit occurred and no billable services were delivered.

Within the role-play, the prospective client is an elderly woman, Miss King, residing in her adult daughter's home. The daughter initiated services following her mother's increased social isolation after the death of her husband six months ago. Miss King is independent with all ADLs including bathing and medication management. She has a diagnosis of diabetes and hypertension, both self-managed. Primary care needs identified are companionship, community transportation (grocery store, hair salon, nail salon), and kitchen assistance. The family confirmed private-pay and expressed readiness to begin services. A service agreement and intake paperwork were completed during the session. An RN comprehensive assessment was scheduled for the following Saturday to complete a full body systems review, document medications, obtain baseline vital signs, and develop the formal care plan. Services were agreed to begin the following Tuesday, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 7:00 PM at a rate of $18 per hour, with consistent caregiver assignment and guaranteed backup coverage. Coach Michelle provided real-time feedback throughout, including guidance on closing the service agreement at time of visit, care plan documentation standards, payroll and billing alignment, and caregiver shoe policy for client homes.
